title: Projektive Geometrie 1 (TUM, Modul MA3203)
description: After successful completion of the module students are able to see how projective geometry forms a broad basis for many (seemingly) different geometric structures. They are able to apply a projective viewpoint to various geometric structures. They understand the role of transformation groups and algebra in this context. 9 ECTS, angeboten in jedem Semester, Version 2020w, verantwortet von Richter-Gebert, Jürgen.
